messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] can't run the demo app deployment
parts:
Hello Leo,
I am guessing that your working directory isn't the one that has your app.R or server.R files.  The easiest thing to do is to run getwd() from the console and see which directory it is.  You can run dir() to see the files in that directory, or if you are using the IDE you should be able to navigate in the files pane to the appropriate directory and set the working directory from the UI.

Best,
Tareef

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] can't run the demo app deployment
parts:
What I do, is I create a sub-directory (for example: Demo), and then I change my working directory to that directory.
Then I will create the ui.R and server.R files specified in the link to the article and save them.  You should see that they are both there in that directory.  
Once you have that, you can then run the deployApp() or you can use the RStudio IDE to deploy it by hitting the publish button.

parts:
Hi Leo,
I just looked at your rtf file and it looks like the directory listing doesn't have an app.R or a ui.R/server.R pair of files.  That is what I was trying to say in the thread earlier.    

You need to create a sub directory with just your application in it.  Change your working directory to be the directory that has the application, and _then_ you can run deployApp()

Hope this helps
